manifest._trimmed: recorded answer; the manifest is cut to the fields the store reads
manifest.name: drawio

permissions.label: Reads the contents of the files it is opened or run on, and of the files it keeps records about

reason.en: To open the diagram you open with it.

permissions.label: Writes files next to the one it is run on, into a folder you choose, or as that file's new version

reason.en: To save the diagram back as a new version.
reason.tr: Diyagramı yeni sürüm olarak geri kaydetmek için.

permissions.label: Runs its own interface in your browser, in a sandbox filex controls

reason.en: draw.io is this app: it runs in your browser, in the sandbox filex draws for it.
reason.tr: Bu uygulama draw.io'nun kendisi: filex'in onun için çizdiği yalıtım alanında, tarayıcınızda çalışır.

permissions.label: Its interface reads its own package - the files of this version, nothing else

reason.en: draw.io loads its own translations, shapes and templates from its package while it runs.
reason.tr: draw.io çalışırken kendi çevirilerini, şekillerini ve şablonlarını paketinden yükler.

permissions.label: Opens .drawio files in its own interface, in place of filex's preview

reason.en: So a .drawio diagram opens in draw.io.

permissions.label: Opens .dio files in its own interface, in place of filex's preview

reason.en: So a .dio diagram opens in draw.io.

permissions.label: Adds a new .drawio file to the New menu; it opens in this app's interface

reason.en: So you can start a new diagram from New document.
reason.tr: Yeni belge'den yeni bir diyagram başlatabilesiniz diye.
